p.title: The Yahoo-to-FRED bridge mapped a 13-week discount rate onto the 3-month constant-maturity series and overwrote the 10Y-3M spread
p.symptom: When FRED was unavailable the bridge filled DGS3MO from Yahoo ^IRX and recomputed T10Y3M from it; ^IRX is the 13-week bill discount rate and DGS3MO is the bond-equivalent yield, so the curve value differed by several basis points; pages also derived a '2Y' from the same rate.
p.root_cause: The two series were treated as the same quantity because both are 'the 3-month rate'.
p.fix: The ^IRX row and the T10Y3M overwrite are removed from the bridge, the dead tnx2y lines are removed, and a missing FRED value stays missing.
p.violated_rule: Missing inputs hold the score; they are never guessed (AGENTS.md).
p.prevention: ci-runtime-contract-check P1541 forbids fredId DGS3MO from Yahoo, the ^TNX-^IRX spread and tnx2y.
